component.name: Astera
component.summary: Keep Claude Code and Codex working while you are away

description.p: Astera is a desktop app for running many Claude Code and Codex sessions side by side, and for keeping them working while you are away.

ul.li: Several sessions in one window, in split panes, each a terminal or a chat view
Several accounts per vendor, and account rolling: a session that hits a usage limit carries on under the next account
Each task in a git worktree of its own
Jobs that split work into tasks, check them with your tests and send what fails back for repair
Scheduled sessions, and Slack notifications and replies

screenshot.caption: Four sessions in one window: three Claude Code and one Codex, on two Claude accounts and a Codex one
